output.notes: Described the headline pretrained Longformer (MLM, continued from RoBERTa; base and large, 4096 tokens). Architecture sizes, norm, activation, biases and tying are inherited from RoBERTa through the explicit 'continue pretraining from the RoBERTa released checkpoint, while only making the minimal changes' statement; the d_ff values are RoBERTa's. Pretraining uses sliding-window attention only (w=512, bidirectional, 256 per side). Global attention with separate projections is added in finetuning. Not described: the char-LM models (Transformer-XL code, relative sinusoidal positions, pre-LN, dilated windows; 12 or 30 layers, 512 hidden, 8 heads) and LED (BART-based encoder-decoder, 16K positions, encoder window 1024). Both are separate settings or variants.
